name: M3_MMS200MI_GetItmWhsBal
description: Retrieve detailed on-hand balance information for a single item in a specific warehouse. Includes stock by status (approved, under inspection, rejected), allocatable and available quantities, consignment balances, and key planning statistics such as annual usage, run-out time, and turnover rate. By default, only high-priority fields are returned. To also retrieve the excess quantity and excess date fields, enable **All Fields Mode** in the request.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse for which to retrieve the item’s balance information.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number whose warehouse balance data will be retrieved.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company for which the item/warehouse balance is retrieved; defaults to the current company if not specified.

inputParameters.name: AFLM
inputParameters.description: Controls whether all item/warehouse balance fields, including descriptions and low-priority data, are returned.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company for which the item/warehouse balance is retrieved; defaults to the current company if not specified.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse for which to retrieve the item’s balance information.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number whose warehouse balance data will be retrieved.

outputParameters.name: STQT
outputParameters.description: Approved on-hand balance quantity for the item in the warehouse.

outputParameters.name: QUQT
outputParameters.description: On-hand balance quantity under inspection for the item in the warehouse.

outputParameters.name: RJQT
outputParameters.description: Rejected on-hand balance quantity for the item in the warehouse.

outputParameters.name: ALQT
outputParameters.description: Allocated quantity of the item in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: AV01
outputParameters.description: Net allocatable quantity for the item in the warehouse after considering on-hand and non-allocatable balances.

outputParameters.name: AVAL
outputParameters.description: Portion of the on-hand balance that is available for allocation.

outputParameters.name: EXQT
outputParameters.description: Excess inventory quantity for the item in the warehouse as calculated in planning.

outputParameters.name: PLQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity printed on picking lists but not yet reported as picked.

outputParameters.name: ORQT
outputParameters.description: Total ordered quantity for the item in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: REQT
outputParameters.description: Total quantity reserved for the item from the current date onward.

outputParameters.name: RLQT
outputParameters.description: Portion of the reserved quantity that is delayed and placed on backorder.

outputParameters.name: AV02
outputParameters.description: Available inventory quantity for the item, calculated as on-hand balance minus all reservations.

outputParameters.name: REQP
outputParameters.description: Quantity reserved against planned orders for the item.

outputParameters.name: IDDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the item was last received into stock in this warehouse.

outputParameters.name: ODDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the item was last issued from stock in this warehouse.

outputParameters.name: INDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the item was last counted in a physical inventory.

outputParameters.name: EXDC
outputParameters.description: Date when the excess inventory quantity was last calculated.

outputParameters.name: PRDC
outputParameters.description: Rule used to determine which date is treated as the priority date for planning and allocation.

outputParameters.name: NUIN
outputParameters.description: Number of records included in the current or last physical inventory for this item/warehouse.

outputParameters.name: USYE
outputParameters.description: Annual usage quantity for the item in this warehouse.

outputParameters.name: AVST
outputParameters.description: Simulated average on-hand balance for the item in the warehouse.

outputParameters.name: DILE
outputParameters.description: Projected on-hand balance at the end of the lead time based on the current material plan.

outputParameters.name: NUS7
outputParameters.description: Number of balance IDs that exist for this item in the warehouse.

outputParameters.name: PRIF
outputParameters.description: Calculated priority value showing how urgently the item needs replenishment.

outputParameters.name: SODY
outputParameters.description: Number of days the current on-hand balance is expected to cover demand without further supply.

outputParameters.name: LYQT
outputParameters.description: Fixed annual demand value stored for the item in this warehouse.

outputParameters.name: LRYE
outputParameters.description: Fixed acquisition requirement quantity used in planning for this item.

outputParameters.name: ZCAC
outputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether on-hand balance has been zero or negative since the last inventory.

outputParameters.name: TURN
outputParameters.description: Turnover rate for the item in the warehouse, calculated as annual usage divided by average on-hand balance.

outputParameters.name: MPCD
outputParameters.description: Date when the item was last included in a material requirements planning run.

outputParameters.name: MPCT
outputParameters.description: Time when the item was last included in a material requirements planning run.

outputParameters.name: DCSS
outputParameters.description: Time-phased safety stock value retained for compatibility and not actively used.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility to which the warehouse and item belong.

outputParameters.name: STCW
outputParameters.description: Approved on-hand balance expressed in catch weight unit of measure (deprecated field).

outputParameters.name: RJCW
outputParameters.description: Rejected on-hand balance expressed in catch weight unit of measure (deprecated field).

outputParameters.name: QUCW
outputParameters.description: On-hand balance under inspection expressed in catch weight unit of measure (deprecated field).

outputParameters.name: CSTQ
outputParameters.description: Approved on-hand balance quantity of consignment stock for the item.

outputParameters.name: CQUQ
outputParameters.description: On-hand consignment quantity under inspection for the item.

outputParameters.name: CRJQ
outputParameters.description: Rejected on-hand consignment quantity for the item.

outputParameters.name: CSTW
outputParameters.description: Approved consignment on-hand balance expressed in catch weight unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: CQUW
outputParameters.description: Consignment on-hand balance under inspection expressed in catch weight unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: CRJW
outputParameters.description: Rejected consignment on-hand balance expressed in catch weight unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: CHN2
outputParameters.description: Change number for the item/warehouse balance record, used for concurrency control.
